diagnostic_evidence.quote: Moreover, given a bisection $L$, the inverse restricted to $L$, $\alpha^{-1}_{|L}$ is also homogeneous: $\alpha^{-1}_{|L}\circ h_z = T^*h_z\circ \alpha^{-1}_{|L}$.

issues.failure_explanation: The inverse of alpha restricted to L is equivariant only when L itself is invariant under the homogeneous action. An arbitrary Lagrangian bisection need not be homogeneous; for example, graphs of nonhomogeneous symplectomorphisms in a homogeneous pair groupoid are Lagrangian bisections. Hence Lagrangianity alone does not make the induced Poisson diffeomorphism homogeneous.
